messages:
Maya L.: Compliance asked for a better way to surface routing-policy changes in the console and in exports. They want attribution + a compact footprint for SIEM ingestion. Thoughts on what fields we should include?

Sam K.: +1. We should emit a single change record per atomic update with: editor, timestamp, justification, diff (old->new weights), rollout_id, affected_routes[]. Also a compact hash/fingerprint so external systems can de-dupe.

Kevin P.: For SIEM it's best to keep each line as a single JSON object (ndjson-style) with a small set of enrichment fields. Example:
```
{"ts":1680000000,"actor":"sam.k@redwood.com","action":"update_routing","route_id":"/v1/generate","before":{"variantA":0.8,"variantB":0.2},"after":{"variantA":0.6,"variantB":0.4},"reason":"performance regression on A","rollout_id":"roll-2026-03-01","fingerprint":"sha256:abc123...","export_mode":"full" }
```
(we can gzip/batch for throughput)

Laura T.: Do we have a default retention + PII redaction policy? Customers want exportable proofs but legal asks to strip emails and tokens. Maybe include actor_id + actor_type and optionally actor_email when requested.

Sam K.: Agree. Proposed export fields: actor_id, actor_type (user/service), actor_email (nullable/stripped), justification_text (must be optional but encouraged), commit_hash, rollout_id, diff, fingerprint, region, tenant_id, export_mode. And an explicit redaction_mode field: "none", "redact_email", "redact_personal".

Maya L.: UX question — in the console where do we show the change? a) inline on route history, b) centralized audit timeline with filters, or c) both. Compliance wants tenant-wide search.

Kevin P.: Both. Inline history is for quick debugging; centralized timeline + server-side filters (by actor, route, rollout_id) for audits. Also add a link in the change record that opens the snapshot view (pre/post) and a quick-revert button if rollout is >0.5 and stale.

Laura T.: For rollout telemetry, we should emit counters: tokens_served_by_variant, latency_p50/p95_by_variant, error_rate_by_variant. Those metrics should be tied to rollout_id so post-hoc analysis is easy.

Sam K.: Ops note: exporting metrics+events to external SIEMs should include a short retention header in the export: "retention_days":30 and a signed_manifest so recipients can verify provenance.

audits-bot: New audit record created by Sam K. (roll-2026-03-01) — fingerprint sha256:abc123... :white_check_mark:

Maya L.: Action items: Sam - draft export schema + redaction modes. Kevin - sample exporter to Splunk/S3 (gzip + manifest). Laura - retention policy + console filters. I'll sync with compliance next Wed.

Sam K.: working on draft now, posting a design doc link shortly.

Kevin P.: will prototype ndjson exporter this week, will include sample Kafka topic layout.

Laura T.: I'll mock filters in the audit timeline. recommend adding a "justification required" toggle on high-impact routes.

Maya L.: thanks everyone :pray:
